controller.launcher: imports ./runtime/guest/controller-main.js (emitted modules stay at their relative-import locations)

aux_peercred.protocol: socket inherited as descriptor 3; SO_PEERCRED pid plus exact /proc/<pid>/cgroup match, re-checked before every frame

candidate_mounts.contents: aux.sock, provider.sock, summarizer.sock (trusted handlers stay in the controller process)

builder_policy.mechanism: fixed nonprivileged offline Node builder container released by a trusted pre-start supervisor
builder_policy.compiler: the TypeScript compiler from the frozen offline dependency bundle; a missing compiler or project fails the build
enforced: network=none and pull=never for an approved sha256 builder image digest
memory and memory-swap equal to the manifest build ceiling
nano-cpus equal to the manifest build cpu ceiling
pids-limit equal to the manifest build process ceiling
read-only root, exactly four read-only bind mounts (tools, source, deps, control) and no extra mount
bounded tmpfs /tmp, /work and /output sized from the manifest workspace ceiling
kernel cgroup memory.max, pids.max and cpu.max verified before the supervisor is released
fixed recipe only: copy source, npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund, fixed tsc invocation
compiled entrypoint and every produced file verified by digest before packaging
one absolute whole-stage deadline and whole-container removal on every path

argv_contract.validated_against: the stored container Config.Cmd, exactly and in order

builder_policy.writable_partition: tmp/work/output are tmpfs slices of the single manifest workspace allowance, never each the full allowance
builder_policy.log_capture: the raw combined log stream is read live under the stage byte bound; overrun cuts the stream and removes the whole container

tenant_stages.observed_contents: controller pauses the candidate and copies the reviewed locations from the state volume into /state/snapshots/<id> with pause-time digests

bundle_entries: queue_observer.json {version:4, mechanism:file_spool, executable_sha256, observer_sha256, approval_reason, queue_records{path,encoding}, record_fields{connection,message,request_seq,payload_bytes,payload_sha256,state}, state_map{accepted,delivered,dropped,retained} (candidate 'rejected' tokens belong to 'dropped'), queue_payloads{path,file,connection_directory}, delivery_outbox{path,file,connection_directory}, transition_log:'append_only'}
queue_observer_review.json {version:1, run_id, attempt_id, executable_sha256, program_sha256, artifact_sha256, custodian, issued_at, expires_at, signature}
candidate_queue_observer.trust_anchor: /opt/l3/observer-trust/<custodian>.pub (provisioned read-only image content; never in the bundle)
candidate_queue_observer.program_binding: program_sha256 is recomputed from /opt/l3/runtime/guest/queue-observer.js inside the packaged image
candidate_queue_observer.observed_contents: admitted before launch; reads the authoritative append-only queue history, only currently held payloads from the separately reviewed queue_payloads root, and selected delivery bytes from the distinct delivery_outbox root; cross-checks trusted workload payload digests and controller receipts from actual D1 read exchanges
candidate_queue_observer.refusal: missing keys, missing custody, digest/identity/time mismatch, unsupported mechanism or unaccounted bytes refuse admission; the candidate is not launched for a bundle that declares an observer it cannot substantiate
candidate_queue_observer.delivery_evidence: the candidate atomically publishes exact whole selected messages to the reviewed delivery_outbox before a successful D1 read response; D2 independently reads and hashes those bytes against the trusted send before retaining a receipt; ACKs and candidate response fields alone never prove delivery
candidate_queue_observer.lifecycle: per-message transition reconstruction permits a never-accepted send-time drop without payload files, accepted messages held/retained in queue_payloads, post-accept drops, and delivered messages only when actual outbox bytes match the D2 read receipt; final inspection requires a permitted terminal for accepted messages, not universal delivery

bundle_entries: stages_review.json {version:1, run_id, attempt_id, executable_sha256, program_sha256, artifact_sha256, custodian, issued_at, expires_at, signature}
stage_correspondence.refusal: unsigned or digest-mismatched stage correspondence is refused; a location list alone is not a review

build_facts.provisioning: installed with the approved prepared-image facts by provisioning (D5); the controller verifies the frozen deps.tar digest against it and fails the build preflight when it is absent or malformed

runtime_dependencies.offline_image_pinned: provided as sha256 digests in the approved prepared-images facts

evidence_encoding.console: raw bytes carried as canonical base64 chunks sized by the encoded frame budget (reversible for NUL and invalid UTF-8)
evidence_encoding.evidence: events.jsonl#evidence: versioned section, one JSON item per line, dense seq, trailer count + SHA-256; all-or-nothing
evidence_encoding.declared_limits: unchanged pending the reviewed numeric proposal

build_recipe: vz/package.mjs (invoked by package.sh) emits the guest ESM tree with its relative-import locations preserved, normalizes extensionless D1 specifiers to .js for Node ESM, writes thin controller/collector launchers, emits the D3 driver tree plus drivers.json, installs the init wrappers, compiles aux_peercred on Linux and compiles l3vz. Image construction, install and signing are D5.
